summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the upgraded Space Explorer 3D WebGL simulator. Incorporates all requested features: Deep Space Nebulae & Pulsars with gravitational lensing, Multi-Star Exoplanetary Systems, Spacecraft Cockpit Flight Simulator, Supernova Collapse & Cosmic Collisions, Time Scrubbing & Orbital Trails, Constellation Overlays, and Guided Interactive Exploration Missions with rich scientific dossiers.
